description: Online suffix-tree construction with a unique terminal and deterministic structural checksum.

source.title: On-Line Construction of Suffix Trees
source.used_for: Online phase extension using an active point, suffix links, open leaf ends, and edge splitting; algorithm idea only.

input.framing_rule: The input length must be exactly n+1; the implementation appends one unique terminal symbol 4.

algorithm_profile.construction: Process each text symbol from left to right, maintaining the active reference pair, suffix links, open leaf ends, and update/canonize/test-and-split transitions.
algorithm_profile.canonical_serialization: Preorder from the root, with child edges ordered by first symbol. Begin with root token 0. For each edge emit [1, edge_length, each edge symbol plus 1, tag]. A leaf uses tag 2 followed by suffix_start+1; an internal node uses tag 3, its children, and closing token 4. Append closing token 4 after the root.

output.meaning: Pack node_count in bits 44+, distinct nonterminal substrings in bits 32..43, and H in bits 0..31. H is the one-based rank-weighted sum of canonical serialization tokens; distinct_substrings is the sum of nonterminal edge-label symbols.
